title: ID0402070-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / R6 170002180] SCB Offline
description:
Reported behavior/issue: There seems to be a power supply that is broken. Can someone visit as soon as possible to fix this please? The other charger is offline so there is no possibility to charge at this station.
Root cause: TB17 faulty
Solution: TB17 replaced
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status: Active
Active case# 0400957
